title: Word-level specificity of spectral anti-concentration: pre-registration
status: DRAFT until scripts/freeze_prereg.py --prereg prereg/word_specificity_prereg.json has written word_specificity_prereg.lock.json and both files are committed. Edit only before freezing.
relation_to_thesis: Added after the two-tail results were known. It tests a question those results left open (whether the published word-level placement is concept-specific) and does not change anything frozen in two_tail_prereg.json. It is reported as a pre-registered addendum, frozen before any word-specificity output was produced.
claim_tested: Word-pair concept directions (difference of means, target minus base) sit further in the low-variance tail of the unembedding spectrum than the difference of means of two arbitrary groups of words of the same size.
gemma_policy: Same as two_tail_prereg.json: every test is reported with and without gemma-2-2b, and a conclusion is called robust only if it holds both ways.
concepts: All 42 files in data/word_pairs/ with at least 4 pairs. No concept is selected or dropped after seeing results.
extraction: Context-free, one activation per word, mean over sequence, max_length 16, via behavioral.layerwise_activations (the extraction phase 0 verified against the published one).

primary.basis: published language subset (results/<model>/en-fr/cov_src.pt); no fallback to full vocabulary
primary.null: lexical: 2n words drawn without replacement from the pooled vocabulary of all concept files, excluding the concept's own words, split at random into two groups of n
primary.statistic: gap = Gini(real) - mean Gini(lexical null), averaged over concepts within a model
primary.test: one-sample t-test of the per-model mean gap against 0 across models, two-sided, alpha 0.05; Wilcoxon signed-rank reported alongside
primary.equivalence: TOST with bounds +/-0.082 Gini units (the placement SESOI already used in the thesis)

decision_rule.specific: mean gap < 0 with the 95% CI excluding 0, in both the all-model and without-gemma versions
decision_rule.not_specific: TOST equivalent within +/-0.082 in both versions
decision_rule.inconclusive: neither; report the interval and say the study cannot decide at n = 8

secondary_reported_not_primary: repartition null (the concept's own 2n words, random split)
isotropic gap (the published comparison), for reference
per-concept-group means (Verb Morphology, Semantic, Semantic expanded, Grammatical, Language Pairs): exploratory, uncorrected
per-concept permutation p-values: descriptive, compared with the 5% expected by chance
multiplicity: One primary test. Secondary rows are reported in full and not used for the conclusion.
